modelspec.artifact.BufferView.title: BufferView
modelspec.artifact.BufferView.description: A typed view of a plan buffer (DESIGN.md § 7.1). size_bytes equals element_count times dtype.size_bytes and offset is a multiple of alignment; ESS states neither here. Device ownership (§ 7.1) is not yet typed.

buffer.description: The plan-local number of the allocation the view lies in (DESIGN.md § 3.1 resources).

offset.description: Start of the allocation range, in bytes (DESIGN.md § 7.1).

size_bytes.description: Length of the allocation range, in bytes (DESIGN.md § 7.1).

alignment.description: Alignment of the view, in bytes (DESIGN.md § 7.1).

modelspec.checkpoint.DType.title: DType
modelspec.checkpoint.DType.description: A tensor element type and its size in bytes; `f32` for every value, `i32` only for row ids an `embedding` reads, never a parameter or a checkpoint tensor (DESIGN.md § 2.2).
